metadata.intro_narrative: Welcome to the abandoned workshop of the late Inventor-General Silas Thorne. The air is thick with the scent of lubricating oil, burning coal, and faint traces of ozone. As you step deeper into the brass-lined room, the heavy iron doors grind shut behind you, sealed by a massive, steam-powered lock system. The pressure gauges are dropping quickly; you do not have much time before the breathable air is entirely replaced by furnace exhaust. Scattered across the heavy oak workbenches are various pneumatic tools, analytical machines, and strange mechanical devices left behind by the mad inventor. To escape this suffocating tomb, you must deduce how to reactivate the master override sequence. You will need to process the correct commands through a series of complex steam-driven apparatuses. Find the starting components, figure out the mechanical sequence, and restore the workshop's systems to unlock the grand doors and secure your freedom.
